evidence.quote: Under-prediction correlates with higher sales target attainment, but only for frontier-closed LLMs. Varying bias and prediction-interval width independently on the synthetic grid isolates

practical_problems.note: controlled forecast bias and interval-width perturbation grid, plus ten model forecasters, measured against negotiation sales-target attainment; standard forecast metrics did not predict outcomes

summary: An arena of two negotiating LLM agents measures how forecast bias and interval width translate into sales-target attainment; forecasts help Buyers, accuracy metrics do not predict outcomes, and bias direction matters only for agents that react to the forecast.
